name: Data Analyzer: The REDCap demo dictionary is listed among the built-in demo dictionaries
objective: Shows the clinical demo dictionary is available for users to select.
precondition: The application's built-in demo catalogue is loaded in the offline test harness; no network and no AI model.

steps.action: Look for the REDCap clinical demo label in the demo dictionary list
steps.expected: The label is present in the list

name: Data Analyzer: The REDCap demo dictionary has content
objective: Shows the demo dictionary returns real text, including a Column heading.
precondition: The application's built-in demo catalogue is loaded in the offline test harness; no network and no AI model.

steps.expected: Text is not empty and contains the word 'Column'

name: Data Analyzer: The REDCap demo dictionary has the standard seven column headings
objective: Shows the demo dictionary follows the same layout as every other demo dictionary.
precondition: The application's built-in demo catalogue is loaded in the offline test harness; no network and no AI model.

steps.action: Read the demo dictionary text as a table
steps.expected: Headings are exactly Column, Type, Required, Min, Max, Description, Allowed_Values, in that order

name: Data Analyzer: The REDCap demo dictionary describes 16 fields
objective: Shows no field was lost or added when the demo dictionary was built.
precondition: The application's built-in demo catalogue is loaded in the offline test harness; no network and no AI model.

steps.action: Read the demo dictionary as a table and count its rows

name: Data Analyzer: The REDCap demo dictionary field names match the expected list
objective: Shows the demo dictionary contains exactly the expected clinical field names.
precondition: The application's built-in demo catalogue is loaded in the offline test harness; no network and no AI model.

steps.action: Collect the field names from the Column heading
steps.data: Expected set of 16 names: subject_id, age, gender, pregnant, weeks_pregnant, due_date, treatment_arm, dosage_mg, placebo_type, diabetes, diabetes_type, insulin_dependent, lab_glucose, adverse_event, ae_description, ae_severity
steps.expected: The set of names is identical to the expected set (the test compares against a list written in the test, it does not open the original source file)

name: Data Analyzer: The REDCap demo dictionary keeps its branching-logic wording
objective: Shows the conditional-display conditions from the original dictionary are still present as descriptive text.
precondition: The application's built-in demo catalogue is loaded in the offline test harness; no network and no AI model.

steps.expected: The text contains the word 'Branching' and the condition fragment gender='Female'

name: Data Analyzer: REDCap demo dictionary converts into per-field rules as the quick-load screen does
objective: Shows the demo dictionary yields 16 field rules with the right allowed values and age range. The conversion steps are written out inside the test (a copy of the screen logic), not run from the application itself.
precondition: The application's built-in demo catalogue is loaded in the offline test harness; no network and no AI model.

steps.action: Convert each dictionary row into a rule (type, min, max, required, allowed values)
steps.expected: 16 rules; gender allowed values are Male, Female, Other; age minimum 18 and maximum 85

name: Data Analyzer: The REDCap demo dataset loads with a sensible number of rows
objective: Shows the matching sample dataset is available and about the expected size.
precondition: The application's built-in demo catalogue is loaded in the offline test harness; no network and no AI model.

steps.action: Load the demo dataset named redcap_clinical
steps.expected: A data table with between 15 and 25 rows

name: Data Analyzer: The demo dataset has a column for every field in the dictionary
objective: Shows the sample data and the sample dictionary line up.
precondition: The application's built-in demo catalogue is loaded in the offline test harness; no network and no AI model.

steps.action: Compare the dataset columns with the dictionary field names
steps.data: redcap_clinical dataset and REDCap demo dictionary
steps.expected: Every dictionary field name is present among the dataset columns

name: Data Analyzer: The demo dataset deliberately includes an age above the allowed maximum
objective: Shows the demo data contains the planted age error (dictionary maximum is 85) so the analyzer has something to find.
precondition: The application's built-in demo catalogue is loaded in the offline test harness; no network and no AI model.

steps.expected: At least one row has age greater than 85

name: Data Analyzer: The demo dataset deliberately includes a gender not in the allowed list
objective: Shows the planted gender error is present (allowed: Male, Female, Other).
precondition: The application's built-in demo catalogue is loaded in the offline test harness; no network and no AI model.

steps.action: Look for gender values outside the allowed list
steps.expected: At least one row has a gender value that is not Male, Female or Other

name: Data Analyzer: The demo dataset deliberately includes a diabetic patient with no glucose result
objective: Shows the planted missing-required-value error is present.
precondition: The application's built-in demo catalogue is loaded in the offline test harness; no network and no AI model.

steps.action: Find rows where diabetes is Yes and glucose is blank
steps.expected: At least one such row exists

name: Data Analyzer: The demo dataset deliberately includes a dosage above the allowed maximum
objective: Shows the planted dosage error (maximum 500 mg) is present.
precondition: The application's built-in demo catalogue is loaded in the offline test harness; no network and no AI model.

steps.action: Look at non-blank dosage values above 500
steps.expected: At least one dosage is greater than 500

name: Data Analyzer: The demo dataset deliberately includes a pregnancy answer for a non-female patient
objective: Shows the planted branching-logic error is present: the pregnancy question should only be answered for females.
precondition: The application's built-in demo catalogue is loaded in the offline test harness; no network and no AI model.

steps.action: Find rows with pregnant = Yes and gender not Female
steps.expected: At least one such row exists

name: Data Analyzer: The REDCap demo dataset key loads a distinct dataset
objective: Shows the redcap_clinical key returns its own data, different from the Western demo, with a subject_id column. The test does not actually use the on-screen dropdown label.
precondition: The application's built-in demo catalogue is loaded in the offline test harness; no network and no AI model.

steps.action: Load datasets redcap_clinical and western and compare
steps.expected: The two results are different objects and the REDCap one has a subject_id column
